attribution.note: Stock footage of a performer who is not part of the team. Cut into short loops; some loops play a stretch backwards. The voice is synthetic (ElevenLabs, voice Bill) and was not spoken by him; his lips are not synchronised to it.

segments.what: Fingers interlaced, smiling, not speaking; sways his head to his right and back. Played out and back from hub 100.
Settles into steepled fingers and lifts them again, smiling, not speaking. Played out and back from hub 181.
Hands clasped low, nearly still; lips slightly apart with small movements that may read as the end of a word. Played out and back from hub 396 (the last 0.7 s of the source).
listen-b at half speed; the missing frames are motion-interpolated (ffmpeg minterpolate, mci).
listen-c at half speed; the missing frames are motion-interpolated (ffmpeg minterpolate, mci).
One short spoken phrase with both hands opening (4.4-5.5 s), then a smiling pause with steepled fingers.
The long explanation: about 7.5 s of continuous talking with wide two-handed gestures, ending as his hands come back together.
